title: WhatsApp
description: Learn how to use WhatsApp for messaging family and friends.

tasks.title: Send a WhatsApp Message
tasks.description: Step‑by‑step guide to open WhatsApp and send a text message.

lessons.title: Open WhatsApp and Send Message
lessons.description: Learn to find WhatsApp, choose a contact, and send a message.

steps.text: Tap the green WhatsApp icon on your phone's home screen.
Tap the green chat button in the bottom right corner.
Find and tap the name of the person you want to message.
Tap the message box at the bottom and type your words.
Tap the green paper-plane button on the right to send.

tasks.title: Send a Photo on WhatsApp
tasks.description: Share memorable pictures with your loved ones.

lessons.title: Pick and Send a Photo
lessons.description: Tap the paperclip icon in a chat, select Gallery, and tap Send.

steps.text: Open a chat with the person you want to send a photo to.
Tap the paperclip or camera icon next to the message box.
Select your photo and tap the green send button.

title: Smartphone Basics
description: Understand basic buttons, volume, and turning your phone on or off.

tasks.title: Adjust the Sound Volume
tasks.description: Learn how to make the ringtone and voice louder or softer.

lessons.title: Using the Volume Buttons
lessons.description: Press the long button on the side of your phone to adjust sound.

steps.text: Locate the volume buttons on the left or right side of your phone.
Press the top button to make it louder, or the bottom button to make it quieter.

title: Google Maps
description: Find directions, search nearby clinics, grocery stores, and bus stops.

tasks.title: Search for a Place Nearby
tasks.description: Type a hospital, park, or shop name to see where it is.

lessons.title: Finding a Destination
lessons.description: Open Maps and type the address in the top search bar.

steps.text: Tap the Google Maps icon on your home screen.
Tap the search bar at the very top and type the destination.
Tap the blue 'Directions' button to see how to get there.

title: QR Codes
description: Easily scan restaurant menus, payment codes, and information boards.

tasks.title: How to Scan a QR Code
tasks.description: Use your phone camera to scan a square barcode.

lessons.title: Point and Scan
lessons.description: Open the camera and point it at the square code.

steps.text: Open your phone's Camera app.
Hold your phone steady in front of the black-and-white square.
A link will appear on your screen. Tap it to open.

title: Photos & Gallery
description: Look at family pictures, zoom in on photos, and organize albums.

tasks.title: Viewing and Zooming In
tasks.description: See your photos bigger by spreading two fingers on the screen.

lessons.title: Zooming into a Photo
lessons.description: Double-tap or pinch to make pictures larger and clearer.

steps.text: Open the Photos or Gallery app.
Tap any photo once to open it full screen.
Pinch outward with two fingers to zoom in and see details.

title: Internet & Browsing
description: Search for news, read recipes, and look up answers on the web.

tasks.title: Search for Information
tasks.description: Use Google to find answers to any question.

lessons.title: Searching on Chrome
lessons.description: Type your question into the address bar at the top.

steps.text: Open the Chrome browser app.
Tap the bar at the top and type what you want to learn.
Press Search or Enter on your keyboard to see the results.
